body:
Harpy Eagle CR 1/2

This magnificent bird has a feathered crest around its head and gray-black-and-white plumage.

XP 200
N Small animal
Init +2; Senses low-light vision; Perception +10

DEFENSE

AC 17, touch 16, flat-footed 12 (+5 Dex, +1 natural, +1 size)
hp 5 (1d8+1)
Fort +3 (+5 vs. disease), Ref +5, Will +2

OFFENSE

Speed 10 ft., fly 80 ft. (average)
Melee 2 talons +2 (1d4+1), bite +2 (1d4+1)

STATISTICS

Str 12, Dex 15, Con 12, Int 2, Wis 15, Cha 7
Base Attack +0; CMB -1; CMD 11
Feats Weapon Finesse
Skills Fly +6, Perception +10; Racial Modifiers +8 Perception

ECOLOGY

Environment tropical forests
Organization solitary or mating pair
Treasure none

One of the larger varieties of eagle, the harpy eagle is found in tropical rain forests nesting in the upper canopy. They are very strong and can lift heavy prey (up to their own body weight) up into their canopy nests to feed. They are also known to have the largest talons among their mundane avian kin.
